Landing.metaTitle: IELTS Writing Task 2 practice with feedback on your own text · GoNative Exams
Landing.metaDescription: Write an IELTS Task 2 essay and get criterion-by-criterion feedback tied to your sentences, with approximate band ranges. Free to try.
Landing.title: Practise IELTS essays with feedback on your own sentences
Landing.lead: Write a Task 2 essay and see exactly what holds it back: comments on each of the four IELTS criteria, mistakes marked in your text and the fixes that matter most.
Landing.ctaNote: 2 free feedbacks a month. Drafts are unlimited. No card needed.

write.title: Write
write.text: Choose one of our practice tasks or paste your own. Your draft saves itself; a 40-minute timer is there if you want exam conditions.

feedback.title: Get feedback
feedback.text: In about half a minute: comments by criterion, mistakes highlighted in your essay, corrections and explanations in English or Russian.

improve.title: Improve
improve.text: Fix the top issues, write a new version and watch your frequent problems become rarer.

Landing.exampleNote: A short example on our own sample text.

sample.explanation: The subject “city centres” is plural, so the verb must be “are”.
sample.summary: Mostly simple sentences; agreement and article errors are noticeable.

criteria.title: All four criteria
criteria.text: Task Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy — each with its own comments.

highlights.title: Mistakes in your text
highlights.text: Every comment points to the exact words it is about, with a correction and a short explanation.

language.title: Explanations in your language
language.text: Choose English or Russian for explanations; corrections are always in English.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.text: See how each criterion changes over your essays and which mistakes you make most often.

tasks.title: Practice tasks
tasks.text: Original tasks in the Task 2 format, written by us and checked before use — or bring your own.

privacy.title: Your essays stay private
privacy.text: Essays are stored encrypted, never published and not used to train AI models. Delete them at any time.

Landing.honestText: You get an approximate estimate of your level by IELTS criteria — a broad range, not an exact band and not an official score. GoNative Exams is not connected with IELTS or its owners. The real value is in the comments: what to fix and why.

official.q: Is this my official IELTS score?
official.a: No. The ranges are approximate practice estimates. Only an official IELTS test gives you an official result.

accuracy.a: Yes. Feedback is produced automatically with AI and can miss a mistake or mark correct language. We tested it on our own essay sets before launch and keep checking it; you can report any comment you disagree with.

training.q: Is my essay used to train AI?
training.a: No. Your essay is sent to our AI provider only to produce your feedback and is not used to train models.

price.a: You can try it for free: 2 feedbacks a month, unlimited drafts.

languages.q: In which languages are the explanations?
languages.a: In English or Russian — you choose. The site itself is in English and Russian.

variants.a: Both. Writing Task 2 is the same in both versions; Task 1 is coming later.
